title: A, B, C, A, B, C
summary: One mutex, one condition and a turn variable make N threads take turns.
hints: A shared `turn` (0, 1, 2). Thread `k` does `lock; while (turn != k) wait; print letter; turn = (turn + 1) % 3; broadcast; unlock;`, `N` times.
Use `pthread_cond_broadcast`: with `signal` the one thread woken may be the wrong one, and the right one keeps sleeping.
